prior.summary: Published source predictions already known; specific matched mechanism new to reviewed catalogue, not first discovery.
prior.case_context: Ti3Ge is already a published calculated proposal. The source ordered A15 state can be new to the reviewed catalogue; no exact experimental superconducting phase was identified by the bounded review.

sources.title: Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds

prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: All three frozen Ti3Ni/Ti3Sn/Ti3Te neighbors remain. The Ge target has the highest separate source Eli response among these four, and the Sn-controlled header proxy remains positive for μ*=.1/.15/.2.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: The exact source neutral zero-applied-pressure model has positive Γ optical compression intervals and no negative retained sampled path value for target and selected control. Coarse/fine force and full stress, relaxation warnings and every q record are retained. These finite observations do not prove full-BZ or thermodynamic hull stability.

proposed_contribution.intervention: Ge-for-Sn on the A15 B role increases ωlog by 37.16–40.61% at all ten common integration tokens despite lowering λ by .0286–.1294; this is a coupled role-substitution hypothesis, not an isolated isotope effect.
proposed_contribution.next_action: Compare saved α²F cumulative λ and logarithmic moment for Ge/Sn under their exact source geometry; discriminate a shift of coupling to higher frequencies from a change of electronic matrix elements. Code-version and finite integration uncertainty stay explicit.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
